title: Check: Surface Area of Cones and Spheres

questions.stem: What is the surface area of a sphere with radius $5\text{ cm}$? Give your answer in terms of $\pi$.
questions.explanation: Surface area of a sphere $= 4\pi r^2 = 4\pi \times 25 = 100\pi\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.stem: The curved surface area of a cone with radius $r$ and slant height $l$ is:
questions.explanation: The curved surface area of a cone is $\pi rl$, where $r$ is the base radius and $l$ is the slant height.

questions.stem: A cone has a base radius of $3\text{ cm}$ and a slant height of $5\text{ cm}$. What is its total surface area in terms of $\pi$?
questions.explanation: Total surface area $= \pi rl + \pi r^2 = \pi(3)(5) + \pi(9) = 15\pi + 9\pi = 24\pi\text{ cm}^2$.
